title: eat shit & die 178
author: bpatrick
html:
Thursday again!? What is happening?

I want to welcome all the new readers and welcome back the long-timers. The site has seen an influx of new readers over the past few weeks which makes me very happy. I hope you guys stick around.

I still owe you guys a new Vivian and a new My Boyfriend Smells. I’m getting to work on those right now.

comments.author: Peter Hon
comments.html: Man, this strip just about described my day. Fuck.

comments.author: Kessbot
comments.html: This is amazing.

comments.author: Stearnsy boy
comments.html: This is my new favorite online comic. Great Stuff, keep up the AWESOME work.

comments.author: kittencontinues
comments.html: Thank you, been reading your comic for some time now. This one totally hit home for me. Your art is awesome. Keep up the good work.

comments.author: David
comments.html: Love this. Can’t wait for more. I’m so glad people are finally finding this.

comments.author: Erick
comments.html: Simple, yet says a lot. I did it

comments.author: Erick
comments.html: dig*

comments.author: flaviano
comments.html: awesome work!

comments.author: Bones
comments.html: Jsyk, the night I came across your site I stayed up until 4 A.M. reading every single comic. I think that was…last Saturday. Keep up the good work, m’bro!

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.html: Sounds like me when I first found akimbocomics.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.html:
Thanks for the encouragement everyone!
@Bones: That is amazing, thank you!
@David: I think you’re the oldest reader that I still hear from. Thanks for sticking around!

comments.author: Just a guy
comments.html: I think the problem is that people are putting their hopes and dreams in things of this world and not above this world. This world and it’s dreams will always let you down. I know a guy who can help if you let him. Think about it.

comments.author: yeah
comments.html: Made me very sad. i hope she doesn’t stop just because of that asshole.

comments.author: knbreit
comments.html: So some guy broke all her bongs and then she found one that survived? Or what?

comments.author: True Story
comments.html: Just A Guy thinks he’s being profound, and shit. I don’t think he’s actually made The Real World’s acquaintance.

comments.author: tzecco
comments.html:
@Just A Guy:

You mean Tom Cruise don’t you?

comments.author: Salem
comments.html: this has pretty much described this last week for me.

comments.author: dizzorderly
comments.html: This pretty much sums up the last 10 years of my life.

comments.author: Michi
comments.html: Thank you for making this, your stuff is amazing, but this really hit home right now, I tear up when I read it, I hope I can find my little yellow vase 🙂

comments.author: yartha
comments.html: Holy shit these comics are some whiney-ass shit. “whaaa life is cruel to me but look im still trying hey look at me and be inspired and shit” Life isnt that bad and if you have a computer and are able to sit reading these comics it never will be. Stop being bitches.

comments.author: Basti
comments.html: Just stumbled upon this. Love it. Well done.

comments.author: dan
comments.html: That is why I keep my hopes and dreams in a cellar. With a lock.

comments.author: jomul7
comments.html: wow I have to post this in the wall of my room!!

comments.author: WolffBrosef2
comments.html:
I like how the ‘World’ guy is smiling in the comic, as though he’s satisfied that he’s doing exactly what he’s supposed to do.

Don’t hate on ‘Just a Guy;’ he was trying to helpful and didn’t say anything harmful or offensive. If anything, I agree with him. We too often put our hopes in things that we know will only be dashed later by the world.
